# Brand asset

`logo.png` is the same artwork with the "MR. NYAMA Smokeeyyy!" wording, used by
the Badilisha PIN reference.

`icon.png` is the supplied Mr. Nyama artwork. It is bundled in `pubspec.yaml`
and reused by `MNLogo` for login, PIN and activation pages, app headers,
and signature confirmation screens. Preserve the original artwork.
